senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.4
a Gibeonite and one of David's mighty warriors
a son of Obadiah and the ruler of the tribe of Zebulun in the time of king David

strongs.def: Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites
strongs.from: or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 (שָׁמַע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will hear
